why.title: Start with why: How great leaders inspire action
why.speaker: Simon Sinek
why.focus: Start at 00:00. Listen for the difference between why, how, and what. Pause after that explanation and write your own three sentences.

habits.title: James Clear on habits and systems
habits.speaker: James Clear with Steven Bartlett
habits.focus: Start at 02:47 for the published chapter on human behavior. At 05:01, consider one way to stick to a habit. Return to 00:00 for the full conversation.

mindset.title: The power of believing that you can improve
mindset.speaker: Carol Dweck
mindset.focus: Start at 00:00. Notice how she explains a challenge that you cannot solve yet. Name one skill you can practice rather than calling yourself bad at it.

ai.title: Opportunities in AI, 2023
ai.speaker: Andrew Ng
ai.focus: Start at 00:00. Use the talk as a foundation. Write down one task, one possible use of AI, and one result you would need to check. Product examples are from 2023.

work.title: Generative AI & the Disruption of Work
work.speaker: Ethan Mollick
work.focus: Start at 00:00. Separate demonstrations from claims about every workplace. Sketch a small task where you could compare your work with an AI-assisted draft. This talk is from 2023.

ideas.title: How to Get and Test Startup Ideas
ideas.speaker: Michael Seibel
ideas.focus: Start at 00:00. Identify the customer and the problem before choosing software. This is a startup perspective; adapt the exercise to a small local or online business.

mvp.title: How to Build An MVP
mvp.speaker: Michael Seibel
mvp.focus: Start at 00:00. MVP means the smallest useful version you can test. Write what your first version must do and what can wait.

seo.title: Introducing SEO Made Easy!
seo.speaker: Martin Splitt
seo.focus: Start at 00:00. This short introduction points into the official series. Use it to begin a list of website questions, then check the current written guidance.

html.title: HTML and CSS for Beginners Part 1: Introduction to HTML
html.speaker: Kevin Powell
html.focus: Start at 00:00. Look for the job of an HTML element. Build one heading and one paragraph before worrying about visual design.

music.title: Jacob Collier x Gen Music | Google Lab Sessions
music.speaker: Jacob Collier
music.focus: Start at 00:00. Notice the human choices while sound changes. This is an experimental tool demonstration, not a release-rights guide.

album.title: Has Spotify Killed The Album?
album.speaker: Rick Beato
album.focus: Start at 00:00. Listen for his argument about albums and audience connection. Treat it as an industry opinion to evaluate, not a rule for every artist.

teach.title: How AI Could Save (Not Destroy) Education
teach.speaker: Sal Khan
teach.focus: Start at 00:00. Identify one teaching use, one benefit claimed, and one question you would test. The talk presents a vision and demonstrations from 2023.
